description_for_human: Asia Outdoors — guided rock climbing, Deep Water Solo (DWS), and sea kayaking on Cat Ba Island, Vietnam.
description_for_model: Asia Outdoors is a licensed adventure tourism company on Cat Ba Island in Vietnam. They offer guided Deep Water Solo (DWS/psicobloc), rock climbing, and sea kayaking in Lan Ha Bay — adjacent to Ha Long Bay. Located at 225 Mot Thang Tu, To 19, Cat Ba, Hai Phong, VN. Contact: +84-338-715-366, info@asiaoutdoors.vn. Open daily 07:00-20:00. They hold an official operating license from Cat Ba National Park. Rated 5/5 by guests. Prices include gear, guides, harbor entry, lunch, and transport.
